The PR adds Android CanvasController URL normalization, WebViewClient main-frame loopback blocking, and parser regression tests for loopback and remote canvas URLs.

PR surface: Other +212. Total +212 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source-reproducible for the direct path: current main stores any nonblank canvas.navigate URL and passes it to WebView.loadUrl, and CanvasScreen has no main-frame URL override filter. I did not run a current-main Android device repro in this read-only review.
